title: How to Prepare a Web Analytics Setup Before Hiring
h1: How to prepare a web analytics setup before hiring
description: Prepare an analytics setup: questions to answer, events to track, accounts and access, privacy and consent, testing and reports to request from a specialist.
intro: Web analytics tells you who visits your site, what they do and which marketing brings results. A careful setup answers real business questions. A rushed one fills dashboards with numbers nobody trusts. This article explains how to prepare before you hire a specialist to install Google Analytics or similar tools, so the data you get is useful from the start.

faq.a: Start with the actions that matter to your business, such as purchases, enquiries and sign-ups, and the sources that bring them.

faq.q: Do I need a tag manager?
faq.a: It is often recommended because it lets you add and change tracking without editing the site code. Ask the specialist what they prefer and why.
Many regions require consent before certain tracking. Ask the specialist to set up a consent banner that fits the rules where your visitors live.
You should. Create or hold the accounts yourself and give the specialist access.

faq.q: How do I know the data is correct?
faq.a: Ask for testing. The specialist should place a test order or submit a test form and show that it appears in the reports.
